title: Class-group factor bases
objective: Implement exact Minkowski, Bach, and BDF factor-base bounds, compact factor-base plans/records, prime-ideal norm streaming, and focused cross-oracle tests

handoff.summary: Implements rational-interval-certified Minkowski, Bach, and BDF bounds; canonical compact factor-base plans and authenticated prime records; deterministic norm-ordered prime-ideal streaming; and six-field Sage/PARI/Magma comparison fixtures including the discriminant-380452 C4 quintic.
risks: The mandatory arithmetic-algebra pnpm test:native gate is intentionally pending for central integration; focused runtime, standalone Pyright, and strict-baselib receipts pass.

When one rational prime has both eligible and ineligible residue degrees, the existing public exact decomposition API materializes all siblings before this module filters by norm; rational primes with no eligible ideals are skipped entirely.
Exact BDF evaluation is deliberately capped and optimized for rigorous planning rather than bulk repeated calls; maximal-order identity caching avoids repeat work in one context.
next_steps: Integration should connect FactorBasePlan and FactorBasePrimeRecord.to_dict() to ClassUnitGroupContext.set_factor_base().
Integration owns the pending pnpm test:native and broad build/precompile gates.
A future selective prime-ideal constructor can avoid materializing ineligible siblings at mixed splitting types without changing the canonical record schema.
